name: Realtime translation sessions
summary: Dedicated Realtime translation endpoints (`wss://.../v1/realtime/translations` + `POST /v1/realtime/translations/client_secrets|calls`); model is `gpt-realtime-translate`, passed as WebSocket query param or in `session.model`.
description: OpenAI exposes a separate Realtime endpoint family for continuous audio translation, distinct from the general realtime chat session. The model is `gpt-realtime-translate`, provided either via the WebSocket `?model=` query string or nested inside the `session.model` field of the client-secret / call request. Two different placements means two different BYOM code paths, neither of which has been validated against a Foundry APIM connection.
notes: Status-only. Split out of the `byom-incompatible-endpoints` realtime rollup — the translation endpoints are a distinct URL family with their own model.
